3namespace Faker\ORM\CakePHP;
4
5use Cake\ORM\TableRegistry;
6
7class EntityPopulator
8{
9    protected $class;
10    protected $connectionName;
11    protected $columnFormatters = [];
12    protected $modifiers = [];
13
14    public function __construct($class)
15    {
16        $this->class = $class;
17    }
18
19    /**
20     * @param string $name
21     */
22    public function __get($name)
23    {
24        return $this->{$name};
25    }
26
27    /**
28     * @param string $name
29     */
30    public function __set($name, $value)
31    {
32        $this->{$name} = $value;
33    }
34
35    public function mergeColumnFormattersWith($columnFormatters)
36    {
37        $this->columnFormatters = array_merge($this->columnFormatters, $columnFormatters);
38    }

41    {

45    /**
46     * @return array
47     */
48    public function guessColumnFormatters($populator)
49    {
50        $formatters = [];
51        $class = $this->class;
52        $table = $this->getTable($class);
53        $schema = $table->schema();
54        $pk = $schema->primaryKey();
55        $guessers = $populator->getGuessers() + ['ColumnTypeGuesser' => new ColumnTypeGuesser($populator->getGenerator())];
56        $isForeignKey = static function ($column) use ($table) {
57            foreach ($table->associations()->type('BelongsTo') as $assoc) {
58                if ($column == $assoc->foreignKey()) {
59                    return true;
60                }
61            }
62
63            return false;
64        };
65
66        foreach ($schema->columns() as $column) {
67            if ($column == $pk[0] || $isForeignKey($column)) {
68                continue;
69            }
70
71            foreach ($guessers as $guesser) {
72                if ($formatter = $guesser->guessFormat($column, $table)) {
73                    $formatters[$column] = $formatter;
74
75                    break;
76                }
77            }
78        }
79
80        return $formatters;
81    }
82
83    /**
84     * @return array
85     */
86    public function guessModifiers()
87    {
88        $modifiers = [];
89        $table = $this->getTable($this->class);
90
91        $belongsTo = $table->associations()->type('BelongsTo');
92
93        foreach ($belongsTo as $assoc) {
94            $modifiers['belongsTo' . $assoc->name()] = function ($data, $insertedEntities) use ($assoc) {
95                $table = $assoc->target();
96                $foreignModel = $table->alias();
97
98                $foreignKeys = [];
99
100                if (!empty($insertedEntities[$foreignModel])) {
101                    $foreignKeys = $insertedEntities[$foreignModel];
102                } else {
103                    $foreignKeys = $table->find('all')
104                    ->select(['id'])
105                    ->map(static function ($row) {
106                        return $row->id;
107                    })
108                    ->toArray();
109                }
110
111                if (empty($foreignKeys)) {
112                    throw new \Exception(sprintf('%s belongsTo %s, which seems empty at this point.', $this->getTable($this->class)->table(), $assoc->table()));
113                }
114
115                $foreignKey = $foreignKeys[array_rand($foreignKeys)];
116                $data[$assoc->foreignKey()] = $foreignKey;
117
118                return $data;
119            };
120        }
121
122        // TODO check if TreeBehavior attached to modify lft/rgt cols
123
124        return $modifiers;
125    }
126
127    /**
128     * @param array $options
129     */
130    public function execute($class, $insertedEntities, $options = [])
131    {
132        $table = $this->getTable($class);
133        $entity = $table->newEntity();
134
135        foreach ($this->columnFormatters as $column => $format) {
136            if (null !== $format) {
137                $entity->{$column} = is_callable($format) ? $format($insertedEntities, $table) : $format;
138            }
139        }
140
141        foreach ($this->modifiers as $modifier) {
142            $entity = $modifier($entity, $insertedEntities);
143        }
144
145        if (!$entity = $table->save($entity, $options)) {
146            throw new \RuntimeException("Failed saving $class record");
147        }
148
149        $pk = $table->primaryKey();
150
151        if (is_string($pk)) {
152            return $entity->{$pk};
153        }
154
155        return $entity->{$pk[0]};
156    }
157
158    public function setConnection($name)
159    {
160        $this->connectionName = $name;
161    }
162
163    protected function getTable($class)
164    {
165        $options = [];
166
167        if (!empty($this->connectionName)) {
168            $options['connection'] = $this->connectionName;
169        }
170
171        return TableRegistry::get($class, $options);
172    }
173}
